name: Volcanic Wastes
description: A scorched wasteland of black obsidian and slow-flowing lava rivers under a smoke-filled sky.
visualTheme: Desolate black volcanic soil cracked open with rivers of yellow-orange lava, under an ash-clouded sky.

history.createdWhy: Created by the eruption of Mount Ignis five centuries ago.
history.builtWho: No one settled here, but fire cults built altars to pray to the mountain deity.
history.majorEvents: The War of Ashes concluded here when the Fire Monarch was entombed.
history.whyExists: Source of highly volatile volcanic minerals and obsidian rocks.
history.currentConflicts: The seal on the fire cult's temple is weakening, causing magma surges.

npcs.name: Scholar Ignatius
dialogue: Do you feel it? The mountain breathes... and it is angry.
Lava is predictable, but the monsters that live inside it are not.
I need samples of obsidian, but my old legs cannot carry me close enough.

secrets.name: Smoldering Shrine
secrets.description: An ancient stone altar glowing with dormant elemental heat.
